## Workload

Kofi Asante completed the grading workload during 387 rostered hours. In that time, he graded 862 sets, giving an average rate of 2.2 per hour. The recorded workload provides a clear basis for reviewing both output and consistency. No change to the current session pattern was identified through the workload review.

## Quality

A further 74 sets were checked as part of the quality review. Agreement between the grading and the subsequent review was 77.0 per cent. The result was considered alongside the recorded workload and supported keeping the current session pattern in place.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
